items.name: ring
items.title: Ring
items.description: Exact dot, lagging ring. Swells on links, squeezes on click.

items.name: trail
items.title: Trail
items.description: A tapering chain of dots, each chasing the one ahead. The head swells over anything clickable.

items.name: blend
items.title: Blend
items.description: Inverts whatever is beneath it. Grows over anything clickable.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Morphs into a pill reading the hovered element's data-cursor-label.

items.name: register
items.title: Register
items.description: A printer's registration mark. Exact crosshair; the ring opens and fills over anything clickable.

items.name: offset
items.title: Offset
items.description: Cyan, magenta and yellow rings that slip out of register as you move. Over a control they grow and misregister.

items.name: ribbon
items.title: Ribbon
items.description: A rainbow ribbon drawn by your path. It fattens and cycles faster over anything clickable.

items.name: confetti
items.title: Confetti
items.description: Sheds confetti as you move, pops a little over each control, and throws a handful on click.

items.name: comet
items.title: Comet
items.description: A bright head whose tail stretches out as you speed up. It swells inside a faint coma over controls.

items.name: orbit
items.title: Orbit
items.description: A moon circling the pointer. Its orbit widens over anything clickable.

items.name: rocket
items.title: Rocket
items.description: The nose is the pointer. It turns to face where you go; the engine roars over controls and cuts on press.

items.name: astronaut
items.title: Astronaut
items.description: Drifts behind the pointer on a slack tether, bobbing in zero gravity. Reels itself in over controls.

items.name: ghost
items.title: Ghost
items.description: Haunts the pointer: floats a little behind, bobs and leans. Swoops in and swells over anything clickable.

items.name: spider
items.title: Spider
items.description: Drops on a thread from the top of its area and sways as you move. Swells and scuttles over controls.

items.name: flashlight
items.title: Flashlight
items.description: Darkens its area except for a pool of light at the pointer, wider over anything clickable.

items.name: gear
items.title: Gear
items.description: A gear that rolls as you travel. Over anything clickable, a second gear meshes in.

items.name: readout
items.title: Readout
items.description: A drafting crosshair with live coordinates. Over a control, it reads the tag and size.

items.name: googly
items.title: Googly
items.description: A pair of googly eyes trailing the pointer, pupils sloshing. They go wide over anything clickable.

items.name: jelly
items.title: Jelly
items.description: A soft blob that stretches along your motion and wobbles back. Swells over controls, squashes on press.

items.name: frame
items.title: Frame
items.description: Viewfinder corners around the pointer that snap to frame whatever clickable thing you hover.

items.name: magnet
items.title: Magnet
items.description: A dot with a pull: over anything clickable, the control leans toward the pointer and the dot settles between them.

items.name: glass
items.title: Glass
items.description: A lens of frosted glass that blurs whatever it passes over. Widens over anything clickable.

items.name: glow
items.title: Glow
items.description: A wide, soft glow drifting after the pointer through shifting color. Gathers tight over anything clickable.

items.name: neon
items.title: Neon
items.description: A humming neon tube that stutters now and then. Swells and switches color over anything clickable.

items.name: sparkle
items.title: Sparkle
items.description: Stars twinkle out along your path, keep coming over controls, and burst in a ring on click.

items.name: splat
items.title: Splat
items.description: A loaded brush: every click leaves a fading splat of paint, each a new color.

items.name: ufo
items.title: UFO
items.description: A saucer hovering above the pointer. Over anything clickable, it lowers a tractor beam onto it.

items.name: constellation
items.title: Constellation
items.description: Draws a constellation as you move, star by star, fading out behind you. A click sets a bright one.

items.name: bat
items.title: Bat
items.description: Flits about beside the pointer. Over anything clickable, it folds its wings and hangs upside down.

items.name: pumpkin
items.title: Pumpkin
items.description: A jack-o'-lantern at the pointer's side. It creeps closer and its face lights up over anything clickable.

items.name: candle
items.title: Candle
items.description: The pointer is a flame: it leans away from your motion, flares over controls and gutters on press.

items.name: compass
items.title: Compass
items.description: The needle swings to your heading, overshoots, and settles north. It spins over anything clickable.

items.name: clock
items.title: Clock
items.description: Keeps your visitor's real time. The hands race forward over controls and wind back on press.

items.name: radar
items.title: Radar
items.description: A scope sweeping round the pointer. Over a control, it sweeps faster and pings a contact on it.

items.name: doodle
items.title: Doodle
items.description: A hand-drawn loop whose line boils. Over anything clickable, it scribbles a circle around it.

items.name: fly
items.title: Fly
items.description: Buzzes around the pointer, lands on anything clickable, and gets shooed off by a click.

items.name: classic
items.title: Classic
items.description: The 1-bit desktop arrow, pixel for pixel: a pointing hand over controls, the hourglass while you press.

items.name: chomp
items.title: Chomp
items.description: An arcade chomper that faces your way and eats as it goes. Gobbles controls; snaps shut on press.

items.name: matrix
items.title: Matrix
items.description: Green code rains off your path, pours over anything clickable, and bursts on click.

items.name: cloud
items.title: Cloud
items.description: A little cloud over the pointer. It drizzles over controls and pours while you press.

items.name: zap
items.title: Zap
items.description: An electric spark that crackles over controls. A click calls down lightning from the top of its area.

items.name: snow
items.title: Snow
items.description: Snowflakes drift off your path. A flurry gathers over controls; a click blows out a gust.

items.name: balloon
items.title: Balloon
items.description: A balloon on a string, tugging up and swaying as you move. Puffs up over controls; a click pops it.

items.name: yoyo
items.title: Yo-yo
items.description: Swings on its string below the pointer. Press to throw it down to sleep; let go to reel it back.

items.name: bubbles
items.title: Bubbles
items.description: Bubbles rise off your path and pop. They stream out over controls; a click pops them all.

items.name: fish
items.title: Fish
items.description: A goldfish that follows and waits just short of the pointer. It nibbles controls and darts off on click.

items.name: jellyfish
items.title: Jellyfish
items.description: Drifts after the pointer in pulses, tentacles trailing. Glows over controls, clenches on press.

items.name: ripple
items.title: Ripple
items.description: A faint wake as you move, rings spreading from every click, and a ring breathing over controls.

items.name: stamp
items.title: Stamp
items.description: A rubber stamp that lifts over controls and leaves a fading inked seal on every click.

items.name: caret
items.title: Caret
items.description: A text caret sized to the line beneath it that blinks when you stop. A block caret over controls.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A tooltip that rises over anything clickable, reading its label or text. No markup needed.

items.name: peek
items.title: Peek
items.description: Shows where a link goes before you click it: the path for links on your site, the host for others.

items.name: focus
items.title: Focus
items.description: Blurs its area except a sharp circle at the pointer, like a shallow depth of field. Opens up over controls.

items.name: goggles
items.title: Goggles
items.description: Night-vision goggles that turn whatever they pass over green. They gain up over controls; a click flashes them.

items.name: dice
items.title: Dice
items.description: A die that tumbles as you move, lands on six over anything clickable, and rolls while you press.

items.name: plane
items.title: Plane
items.description: A paper plane that glides after the pointer and banks into its turns. It circles controls; a click throws it.

items.name: snake
items.title: Snake
items.description: The phone-game snake, chasing the pointer square by square. It grows over controls and speeds up on press.

items.name: pixel
items.title: Pixel
items.description: A pixel cursor on an 8px grid with a stepped, fading trail. Over controls it draws a blinking selection.

items.name: sun
items.title: Sun
items.description: A sun whose rays turn slowly. They stretch and spin over anything clickable; a press brings an eclipse.

items.name: tornado
items.title: Tornado
items.description: A twister whose funnel sways and leans behind your motion. It towers over controls and whips round on press.

items.name: black-hole
items.title: Black hole
items.description: Bends the page round it like a lens and swallows dust from your path. Swells over controls; hold, and time slows.

items.name: top
items.title: Top
items.description: A spinning top that wobbles and teeters when you stop, but never falls. Controls sink into dream levels; a click kicks it.

items.name: rune
items.title: Rune
items.description: A gold ring whose runes kindle over controls and stir when you idle. Hold to put it on: you vanish and the page greys.

items.name: galley
items.title: Galley
items.description: A Greek galley with a wake. Monsters surface round it, the Gorgon turns it to stone, sirens sing from controls.

items.name: element
items.title: Element
items.description: Ho, for hover. Spells a control's name in periodic-table tiles; hold to excite the atom, let go for its flame color.

items.name: saber
items.title: Saber
items.description: An energy blade that ignites as you arrive and streaks as you swing. It guards over controls, clashes on click, and powers down when still.

items.name: magnifier
items.title: Magnifier
items.description: A magnifying glass that really enlarges the page under it. Closer over controls, closer still while you hold.

items.name: wand
items.title: Wand
items.description: Spell sparks trail the tip, which lights over controls. Click for a burst; draw a circle to cast a shield.

items.name: laser
items.title: Laser
items.description: The pointer is a laser dot and a cat chases it: it creeps, wiggles and pounces, bats at controls and naps when you stop.

items.name: fireworks
items.title: Fireworks
items.description: Hold to pack a shell, let go to launch it: a peony, a ring, a willow or a crackle in turn. Entering a control pops a ring of sparks.

items.name: droplet
items.title: Droplet
items.description: A water drop that refracts the page under it. Swells over controls; a click sends ripples through the page, bending its words.

items.name: mercury
items.title: Mercury
items.description: A bead of liquid metal that sloshes after you and sheds droplets when you move fast. A click bursts it; the drops roll home.

items.name: halftone
items.title: Halftone
items.description: A halftone dot screen round the pointer. Over controls it turns to the next ink's angle; hold to spread the ink, click to pulse.

items.name: fireflies
items.title: Fireflies
items.description: A blinking swarm round the pointer. Over a control they settle along its edge and fall into step, flashing together.

items.name: leaves
items.title: Leaves
items.description: Autumn leaves tumble off your path and pile up on top of controls. A click is a gust that blows them all away.

items.name: smoke
items.title: Smoke
items.description: An ember with smoke curling up from it, swirling round controls. A click blows a smoke ring that rises as it widens.

items.name: galaxy
items.title: Galaxy
items.description: A spiral galaxy turning round the pointer, its arms trailing as you move. Over controls the stars trace the outline; press for a supernova.

items.name: liquid
items.title: Liquid
items.description: A drop of liquid glass that bends the page at its rim. Over controls it flows out to wrap them in a glass pill; press to squeeze it.

items.name: gecko
items.title: Gecko
items.description: A gecko that stalks the pointer like a bug, its feet planting and stepping as it runs. It flicks its tongue at controls; a click and it lunges.

items.name: use-cursor
items.title: useCursor
items.description: The cursor engine every hover-ui cursor runs on: turns its parent element into a cursor area and calls your frame function while a mouse is inside.
